title: Payoff Quote Validity and Closing Timelines — Kestrel Auto Finance
content:
For Kestrel Auto Finance Retail Installment Contracts, the closing timelines below apply by tier: how long a payoff quote is good for, and how quickly the lien release, a payoff overpayment refund and a refund of installments after an unwind are sent.

| Tier | Payoff quote validity (calendar days, quote date as day 0) | Lien release after payoff (business days) | Payoff overpayment refund (business days) | Refund of installments paid after an unwind (business days) |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Kestrel Finance Tier E | 10 | 10 | 10 | 7 |
| Kestrel Finance Tier D | 10 | 10 | 10 | 7 |
| Kestrel Finance Tier C | 10 | 10 | 10 | 7 |
| Kestrel Finance Tier B | 10 | 10 | 10 | 7 |
| Kestrel Finance Tier A | 10 | 10 | 10 | 7 |
| Kestrel Finance Tier A+ | 10 | 10 | 10 | 7 |

All six tiers share the same figures. Hypothetical: a payoff quote dated the 3rd of a month is good through the 13th of that month (day 0 is the 3rd, day 10 is the 13th).
